worldcombat.skill.tripledive.summary: Three short hops in a row: each dive first takes a nearby free-aim landing point, really launches, and drives down toward it, settling on the first enemy body it meets in the fall or on any enemy inside the landing splash. Every landed dive drenches the target, and an already soaked target takes the next dive harder; between dives you can pick a new point, a new enemy, or hop to reposition.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.use.0: Dive three times for real, switching to another enemy between hops
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.use.1: Open by drenching the target so the later dives take the full bonus
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.use.2: Use empty hops to reposition, close in or slip around obstacles
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.description: Each of the three dives deals about %1$s Water contact damage, reaching a landing point within %2$s blocks with a %3$s block splash radius; the target's Defence, type matchup and crits are settled per dive.
Every landed dive drenches the target and refreshes it to %2$s; against a target that is already drenched, that dive's power rises to %1$s. Each dive settles only the first enemy it really touches.
Each launch rises at about %1$s blocks/tick and falls at about %2$s blocks/tick; Speed sets how fast it rises and Weight how hard it drops.

Every dive is a real short arc of the body: on take-off it reads a free-aim landing point within %1$s blocks and then moves tick by tick. It settles only on the first enemy body it touches in the fall, or on an enemy inside the %2$s block splash when it lands; between dives you can pick a new point, switch to another enemy or hop to reposition. A block overhead turns the rise into a fall early, and a wall stops the lateral move at the point actually reached, never a teleport.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.plunge.on: Deep Plunge: higher leaps, each dive 20 percent heavier, splash radius x1.2 and drench duration x1.25, but the rhythm is +2 ticks and the cooldown +6 ticks: harder hits on a longer window for the target.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.plunge.off: Quick Hop: faster dives, each 10 percent lighter and a shorter cycle, but smaller splashes and a shorter drench: steadier and denser, lighter per hit.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.growth.0: From level %1$s each dive rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.growth.1: From level %1$s each dive rises to %2$s and the drench lasts %3$s.
On: each dive x1.2, splash radius x1.2, drench x1.25, but rhythm +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (Quick Hop): each dive x0.9, normal rhythm and cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of leaping. The reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets already carrying drenched rank higher (every dive takes the soak bonus); off: every target scores the same.
On: bulky targets (easier to touch, wider splash coverage) score higher; off: only drench and distance matter.
world_combat.move.tripledive.text.full: All three dives land (%1$s dives, %2$s hits)
